correctness.rationale: A three-to-one cyclic increment coding under the exact modulo-three closure condition and the local iff homogeneous-triple swap test reduce the problem to a finite-state weighted trace. Explicit determinants are D0=(1-z-z²)(1+z+z²), D1=(1-z)(1+z+z³), and the cubic eigenvalue power sums obey the claimed recurrence. Even and odd constructions certify the exact nonzero-length classification. Direct brute-force all proper named colorings through n=13 (16,374 configurations), exhaustive eligible sign words through n=20, and integer matrix checks independently match the proof.
